dialogues.speaker: Luzerne
dialogues.text: The Opera Epiclese is home to both performances and the court trials. The founder of the opera house, Focalors, recognizes them both as things that may be performed at the opera house.

dialogues.speaker: Luzerne
dialogues.text: The insipid, the absurd, the shocking and the sorrowful... So long as you visit enough times, you will be able to experience all this at the Opera Epiclese.

dialogues.speaker: Luzerne
dialogues.text: Some people enjoy watching the emotions involved in real cases, while others prefer the interpretations and hype involved in theater productions.

dialogues.speaker: Luzerne
dialogues.text: But when judgment has been passed and the curtain has fallen, it is time to return to reality and form an objective view of what has transpired.
